before_after.population_note: The historical population is NOT the same bytes as the fixed family: those bundles predate the fix and are preserved as evidence. The same-decision per-row BEFORE/AFTER pairs below are published from the seam's own downgrade records on the fixed path; no historical bundle is rewritten or deleted.

claim_ceiling: REPORTED-ONLY measurement of committed bundle bytes under the frozen D1-D4 content predicates. It re-derives no frozen scorer population or emission predicate, scores no frozen bar, evaluates no serve verdict and makes no legal-usefulness claim. Historical bundles that predate the fix are preserved evidence, not current-head defects.
family_definition: fixed_path_family = bundle provenance carries counter_evidence_span.content_filter (regenerated on the fixed path); identified from the bytes, never hard-coded

frozen_predicate_provenance.alignment: constants copied verbatim from the frozen classify_verified_row predicates; this filter only narrows evidence, it never edits the frozen confirm-or-abstain gate, rubric, threshold or bar

packet_v3_reemission.claim_ceiling: Deterministic re-run of the ACCEPTED product arm over frozen packet-of-record v3 bytes on deep copies. It writes no packet byte, edits no frozen predicate and re-scores no frozen bar. Support-among-emitted, abstention count and yield are published together; nothing here asserts that a decision IS supporting, contrary or limiting, and no serve verdict is produced.

v68_rejection_effect_on_v3.note: The rejection/incumbent leg only downgrades verified evidence that fails the frozen D1-D4 predicates.  Packet-of-record v3 bytes carry no verified defective incumbent, so this leg changes nothing on those bytes; the guarded arm's emission is the accepted span seam's own row and is content-clean.
